project_specification.project_name: nullius — VST fidelity harness: measure live fills against the cost model (M4 groundwork)
project_specification.addition_summary: PRD §11.1 makes the fidelity harness M4's deliverable: prove that live fills, latency, partial fills, rounding and funding match the simulator to within a few basis points. The BingX VST paper bot already trades every 4 hours, but an audit on 2026-10-07 found that its forward_cost_reconciliation is not a simulator check: - modeled_cost_bps is only the published fee rate. The cost-model member (book_walk, passive_fill, queue_penalty, latency) is never consulted. - realized is measured against the order's own limit, so a passive fill always shows 0 slippage (hence rows of exactly 0.0). - The decision-time mark, latency, fill ratio, actual commission, rejects, rounding drift and funding are not recorded, and nothing writes the ops live metrics. This spec records what is needed per order and per slot, prices the expected cost with the cost model before each trade, ingests funding, and reports the fidelity distributions. M4 can then start with months of fidelity data already accumulated.

existing_context.stack: Python 3.12 / uv-workspace / SQLite at DATABASE_URL (default ~/.local/share/nullius/vst.db for the bot) / pytest.
existing_context.test_baseline: main after bug_spec_pit_universe.xml: gate command (uv run --all-packages pytest -n 4 --dist loadfile) 1648 passed; router member suite green.
existing_context.conventions:
Follow CLAUDE.md, especially its BingX VST section: - Only bingx_flatten --confirm and the daily-loss guard close positions. Nothing here places, cancels or closes anything new. - Live API shapes are pinned in packages/router/tests/fixtures/bingx_vst/live/. Extend those fixtures; never guess a venue shape. - Tests never reach the network or read a credential, and pass under pytest-xdist with tmp stores. - A router store adds columns to an existing table with a probe-then-ALTER (PRAGMA table_info, then ALTER TABLE ... ADD COLUMN), never a rebuild, so the live vst.db upgrades in place. House CLI pattern as in router/bingx_heartbeat.py.
Pinned live shapes, captured 2026-10-07 from the VST account by read-only signed GETs: - live/query_order_filled.json: GET /openApi/swap/v2/trade/order for a FILLED LIMIT ETH-USDT order. data.order carries origQty, executedQty, price, avgPrice, commission (negative when charged, e.g. "-0.004213"), status "FILLED", time (placement, ms) and updateTime (last fill, ms). postOnly reads false even for the bot's PostOnly orders, which use timeInForce instead. - live/income_funding_fee.json: GET /openApi/swap/v2/user/income with incomeType=FUNDING_FEE. data is a list of {symbol, incomeType "FUNDING_FEE", income (signed string), asset "VST", info, time (ms), tranId, tradeId}.
Existing pieces: - router/bingx_mirror.py: build_mirror_plan, reprice_passive_order (~:1084), _order_recorder and _place_one (~:1390). - router/submission_result.py: router_order_record (client_order_id, book_id, rebalance_ts, symbol, side, type, quantity, reference_price, placed_at). - router/bingx_reconcile.py: reconcile_rebalance_fill_costs (~:646-870) and read_back_orders (~:759). - router/bingx_orders.py: VSTOrderStatus parses status, original and executed quantity, and avgPrice. - router/bingx_rebalance.py: step 3 reconciles the previous slot (~:1024). - router/submission_health.py: RouterSubmissionHealthStore.record (no production caller). - ops/live_metrics.py: LiveMetricsStore (fill_cost_bps, reject_rate; no production writer). - cost-model member: book_walk.py, passive_fill.py, queue_penalty.py, latency.py.

category.name: Per-Order Capture
category.feature: System declares the router member's dependency on the cost-model workspace member, so that `python -c "import router, cost_model"` returns without ImportError in a fresh `uv sync --all-packages` environment. - The cost-model member is added to packages/router/pyproject.toml dependencies, and uv.lock is regenerated with `uv lock`. No other dependency changes.

System saves each placed order's decision-time facts and its pre-trade expected cost to router_order_record, so that every order row returns what the simulator predicted before the venue answered. - New nullable columns, added by probe-then-ALTER: - decision_mark: the premiumIndex mark the plan was built from - best_bid, best_ask: from the depth read used for repricing, null for MARKET legs - pre_reprice_limit: the limit before reprice_passive_order - target_quantity: the quantity before step/tick rounding - expected_cost_bps: the cost model's pre-trade estimate. For MARKET legs this is book_walk over the recorded depth plus the taker fee. For LIMIT legs it is passive_fill's expected cost with queue_penalty plus the maker fee. Null when the cost model refuses, never 0. - cost_model_version - sent_at, acked_at: UTC ISO-8601 around the place call in _place_one - Existing rows and columns are unchanged, and placement behaviour is identical: no order differs in symbol, side, type, quantity, price or client id. - Tests use the pinned plan fixtures: every placed leg's row carries the new fields; a MARKET leg's best_bid/best_ask are null; a cost model refusal gives a null expected_cost_bps; an existing vst.db without the columns upgrades in place; the placement bodies are byte-identical to before.

System saves each order's final venue state to a new append-only router_order_fill table at reconciliation, so that every order of a reconciled slot returns its fill ratio, average price, actual commission and fill latency. - VSTOrderStatus also parses commission (signed), time and updateTime (ms), and keeps the raw status, matching the pinned query_order_filled.json and query_order_pending.json. - read_back_orders' results are persisted once per client_order_id (idempotent): - status - original_quantity, executed_quantity, fill_ratio - avg_price - commission (as the venue reports it) and commission_bps (of filled notional, positive meaning a cost) - placed_ms and last_fill_ms from the venue, place_to_fill_ms - read_at Partially filled orders are recorded with their partial executed quantity before step 2 of the next slot cancels the remainder. - Tests: the pinned FILLED fixture yields fill_ratio 1.0, the commission bps and a place_to_fill_ms of 23000. A PENDING order yields fill_ratio 0. A re-read writes no duplicate. No network.

System saves the VST account's funding-fee income to a router_funding_income table, so that each slot's funding cost returns as a stored, per-symbol figure. - BingXClient.income(income_type, *, start_ms=None, end_ms=None, limit=None) is a signed GET on /openApi/swap/v2/user/income, returning the data list. - router.bingx_funding.ingest_funding(client, store, *, since_ms) stores each FUNDING_FEE row (symbol, income as Decimal text, asset, time, tranId), idempotent on tranId, and returns the count of new rows. - Tests use the pinned income_funding_fee.json through a stub transport: rows are stored, re-ingest is idempotent, and a non-zero code is refused with the client's existing refusal. No network.

category.name: Fidelity Reconciliation and Reporting
category.feature: System compares every filled order's realized cost against the cost model's pre-trade estimate and saves the per-order and per-slot fidelity, so that each reconciled slot returns real sim-versus-live gaps rather than fee-only figures. - router.fidelity.reconcile_fidelity(slot, *, database_url) computes, per filled order: - realized_cost_bps = signed slippage of avg_price against decision_mark + commission_bps - expected_cost_bps (from feature 2) - gap_bps = realized minus expected - maker (fill at the limit, or a negative or zero fee rate implying maker) - place_to_fill_ms Per slot it computes the notional-weighted means, the slot's funding bps over its notional from feature 4, and counts of legs, fills, partials and rejects. It writes router_order_fidelity and router_slot_fidelity (append-only, idempotent per slot). - bingx_rebalance step 3 calls it after the existing reconciliation (which stays unchanged). It then writes fill_cost_bps (the slot's mean gap_bps) and reject_rate to ops LiveMetricsStore, and records each rejected leg via RouterSubmissionHealthStore.record. - It never places, cancels or closes, and the slot's exit codes are unchanged. - A reconciliation fault is logged and the slot still completes, the same stance as the alert path. - Tests over fixtures: a MARKET fill slipping 5 bps against the mark, with a 4 bps expected cost, gives gap 1 bp plus fees. A PostOnly fill repriced away from the mark shows the passive cost the old reconciliation hid. Funding is attributed. A rejected leg increments reject_rate and submission health. The step is idempotent.

System reports the fidelity distributions from `python -m router.vst_fidelity [--since YYYY-MM-DD] [--book ID]` and displays one JSON object. - The object carries: - n_orders, n_slots - gap_bps mean with a 95% bootstrap interval (seeded, so it is deterministic) - realized_cost_bps and expected_cost_bps p50/p95 - place_to_fill_ms p50/p95/p99 - fill_ratio mean, maker_share, reject_rate - rounding drift (target versus sent quantity, in bps of notional) - funding_bps_per_day - a within_tolerance flag against the PRD §11.1 bar: |gap_bps mean| at most 3 bps, with the threshold a documented module constant - An empty store gives n_orders 0 and exit 0. A missing DATABASE_URL exits 2. - run.sh gains `vst-fidelity` (no op run; it reads the store only, with DATABASE_URL defaulting to ~/.local/share/nullius/vst.db as the other vst verbs do). It is listed by `./run.sh help`. - Tests cover the distributions over a seeded fixture store, the empty store, the missing DATABASE_URL and the tolerance flag.

project_specification.integration_points: Feature 1 comes first. Features 2, 3 and 4 capture; feature 5 joins them; feature 6 reports.
project_specification.out_of_scope: Changing what the bot trades or how it places orders. Live capital. Running evaluation inside the evaluator image. WebSocket staleness and rate-limit headroom (their writers are later work).
